metadata.title: On do Carmo's Question: The Properly Embedded Case
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we prove that every complete noncompact two-sided properly embedded constant mean curvature hypersurface of finite Morse index in Euclidean space is minimal. The result holds in every dimension. We assume no bounds on curvature or volume growth. This establishes the properly embedded case of the finite-index version of do Carmo's question. For nonzero mean curvature, we use the radii of inscribed balls to define a positive weight. This weight gives a polynomial bound on weighted volume, while its reciprocal satisfies a differential inequality involving the Jacobi operator. We combine these properties with stability outside a compact set to obtain finite total area. This leads to a contradiction.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究任意维欧氏空间中有限 Morse 指数的完备、非紧、双侧、适当嵌入 CMC 超曲面。
techniques: 加权体积估计与 Jacobi 算子
analysis.breakthrough: 适当嵌入提供朝向平均曲率一侧的内接球半径ρ；ρdV有多项式增长，而μ=1/ρ满足带Jacobi势的分布不等式。有限指数给紧集外稳定性，两者结合推出有限总面积，与非紧CMC的无限体积结果矛盾。
analysis.limitations: 主定理为n≥2、无边界、连通、完备非紧双侧适当嵌入及有限 Morse 指数。对一般浸入，构造同类正权仍是导言列出的剩余问题。补读主定理及前3页分析路线，未独立核验弱微分不等式或全证。
